Marketing agencies love to brag about how many leads they generated.

But here's the question nobody asks...

💉 How many of those patients actually came back?

If your "new patient" gets Botox once, spends $300, says no to everything else, and disappears for the next 6 months...

You don't have a marketing problem.

You have a patient value problem.

Most agencies stop after the appointment gets booked.

We don't.

At The Luxora Collective, we help med spas:
✨ Attract higher-quality patients
✨ Train teams to increase conversions and upsells
✨ Build memberships and retention systems
✨ Turn one-time Botox appointments into lifetime clients worth thousands

Because real growth isn't about constantly replacing patients.

It's about keeping the ones you've already paid to acquire.

If you're stuck on the marketing hamster wheel, it's time to fix what happens after the patient walks through your door.

📲 Book a Growth Strategy Call and let's build a practice that grows with lifetime clients, not one-time appointments.

Write a tiktok post about this video ad: Thank you! This makes more sense:

You hired a marketing agency.
The ads are running. Appointments are getting booked. New patients are walking through the door.
Great... except then this keeps happening.
They come in.
Get a couple hundred dollars of Botox.
Say no to everything else.
And then...
You never see them again.
Three months go by. Six months go by.
Gone.
So now you have to keep spending more money to find another new patient to replace the one you just lost.
That’s not predictable growth. That’s a revolving door.
At The Luxora Collective, we fix the entire process.
We help you attract quality patients who are actually interested in more than the cheapest offer.
Then we train your team to convert and upsell those patients into the right services, packages and memberships.
And we implement the retention systems that keep them coming back three, four or more times a year.
Because the goal isn’t to get someone through your door once for a few hundred dollars.
The goal is to turn that new patient into a lifetime client worth thousands.
And I know how to do that because I spent over a decade running and growing aesthetics practices before I ever touched an ad account.
I know what happens after the patient walks through the door.
That’s why The Luxora Collective is different.
We don’t just get you leads.
We help you turn new patients into higher-value, returning clients.
If you're tired of paying to fill a revolving door with one-and-done patients...
Stop doom scrolling and book the call.
Let’s turn those one-time patients into lifetime paying clients.
